title: Indications of Further Prosecution When Those in Money Laundering Case Are Deported to Home Countries
what_it_is: Indications of Further Prosecution When Those in Money Laundering Case Are Deported to Home Countries

sections.label: Deported convicted foreigners barred re-entry
sections.summary: Eight of 10 convicted foreigners were deported and barred from re-entering Singapore, with the same applying to the remaining two after their sentences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: As at end June 2024, eight of the 10 convicted foreigners have been deported and are barred from re-entering Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: This similarly applies to the remaining two after they finish serving their sentences.

sections.label: Singapore extradition treaties and arrangements
sections.summary: Singapore has extradition treaties with four jurisdictions and arrangements with about 40 Commonwealth territories, Malaysia and Brunei, and is open to more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Currently, we have extradition treaties with the United States, Germany, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and Indonesia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: We also have extradition arrangements with about 40 declared Commonwealth territories.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: These include Australia, Canada, New Zealand, India and the United Kingdom.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: In addition, we have reciprocal arrangements with Malaysia and Brunei based on endorsement of arrest warrants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: So, we have already a significant extradition network with about 44 jurisdictions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: For extradition arrangements, we will have to look at it to see whether there are adequate protections, whether it carries risk to the people of Singapore, because the shoe can be on the other foot as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: We are open to more extradition arrangements, but we will continue to take a careful and considered approach.
